name: La Bella Cafe & Games
notes: Site branding calls this location "La Bella Pizza" (the restaurant group's shared name across its two Chula Vista locations), but the address 289 G Street, Chula Vista, CA 91910 matches the work list exactly, and the Popmenu location record's own name field is literally "La Bella Cafe & Games" (location id 5565, phone (619) 426-8830) -- distinct from the other location "La Bella Pizza Garden" at 373 Third Avenue (id 5560). Used the EXACT work-list name per house rules despite the page chrome saying "La Bella Pizza". Categories reached: Appetizers, Soups & Salads, Our Famous Pizza, Dinners, Pasta Dishes, Sandwiches, Family Meals & Pizza Party Combo, Dishes Served Family/Half Catering Trays, Desserts -- all 9 sections of the "Dine In Take-Out Delivery" menu (the complete core food menu). A separate "Craft Brew & Fine Wines" menu (beer taps + wine list, adjunct) rendered 0 items server-side for this location -- checked, not core, excluded. A "Catering" menu tab also exists and was not opened (adjunct to the dine-in menu, which already includes a family/catering-tray section). Prices for items with a single size came straight from the page's JSON-LD (schema.org Menu, 48 items). The other 34 items use Popmenu's per-size pricing (wings, pizzas by size, pasta plate/platter, catering trays) which is absent from the section JSON-LD (offers: null) and only appears in each item's own page under window.POPMENU_APOLLO_STATE (MenuItem.sizes -> MenuItemSize.price) -- fetched all 34 item pages individually and expanded each size into its own dish row, e.g. "Original Buffalo Wings (Small)" / "(Large)".

name: Señor Pancho Fresh Mexican Grill
notes: Work list had no website. Restaurant's own site (senorpanchofreshmexicangrill.com, Owner.com platform) and its NetWaiter listing (senor-pancho-fresh-mexican-grill.netwaiter.com) both render menus client-side with no prices in the raw HTML/JSON-LD -- needs a browser. Used DoorDash marketplace schema.org Menu JSON-LD instead (server-rendered, address 298 Montgomery St, Chula Vista matches exactly). Markup check against 1.04/1.1/1.15/1.18/1.2/1.22/1.24/1.25/1.3 found no dominant clean divisor (best was 1.25 at 52% loosely-clean, only 15% strictly round) -- treated as ordinary odd-cent menu pricing, not a uniform surcharge, but kept confidence at medium per source-ladder tier for a delivery marketplace. Excluded the 'Most Ordered' section (12 items) as it duplicates items already listed under their real categories (Burritos, Nachos & Fries, Tacos, etc.). Sections captured: Meal Deal, 2 Enchiladas, Quesadillas, Tacos - Soft Shell, Tacos - Hard Shell, 3 Mini Tacos, Burritos, Supreme Tostadas, Tortas, Nachos & Fries, Tostadas, Mariscos, Caldos, Combinations.

notes: Work list gave foodeist.com, an aggregator/directory page with no priced menu (only a price-tier symbol, no dish prices, no server-rendered menu data). No independent restaurant-owned website found; other results were third-party directories (zmenu render was a JS shell with no extractable text, weeblyte.com and res-menu.net are barred/unreliable per playbook). Used DoorDash marketplace schema.org Menu JSON-LD (server-rendered even though the store showed 'Closed now' at fetch time -- that is a store-hours state, not an absent menu). Address 9535 Mission Gorge Rd, Santee matches the work list exactly. Markup check against 1.04/1.1/1.15/1.18/1.2/1.25/1.3 found no dominant divisor -- ordinary odd-cent menu pricing (many items already end in .95/.00 natively), not a uniform delivery surcharge. Sections: Appetizers, Soups Noodles & Rice, Salads, Nigiri Sushi (2 Pcs) [sashimi/nigiri], Special Rolls, Classic Rolls -- appears to be the restaurant's full sushi-bar menu (rolls, nigiri, apps, soups, salads all present).
